description: Arbitrum One — mirrors the live HyperEVM v0.8.5 deployment (Symmio 0x57331038c21982116EE9b0906E4a5c5cB52dcE2e). Values marked UNVERIFIED below could not be read from chain and are still the built-in defaults — confirm them before a mainnet run.

readFromChain: muon validity = 60/60 (getMuonConfig) — set via MUON_UPNL_VALID_TIME / MUON_PRICE_VALID_TIME in .env, not this file
_provenance.why: These have no on-chain getter. They are recoverable from Set* events, but the public HyperEVM RPC rejects historical eth_getLogs. Re-run scripts/exportProtocolConfig.ts against an archive RPC to fill them in.

_notes.balanceLimitPerUser: Raw collateral-token units. HyperEVM collateral is 6-decimal USDC, and Arbitrum USDC is also 6 decimals, so this value ports directly. Be aware 1e24 raw = 1e18 USDC per user, i.e. effectively no cap — that is what HyperEVM runs today. The old built-in default (parseEther("10000") = 1e22) was written assuming an 18-decimal collateral and is equally meaningless against USDC; set a real number here if you want an actual limit.
_notes.deallocateCooldown: 0 on HyperEVM (read via getMinWithdrawCooldown). The setter is still named setDeallocateCooldown; the storage field was renamed to minWithdrawCooldown.
_notes.templateOrder: Template ids are assigned in array order and hedgers reference templates by id. HyperEVM's id 3 is INSTANT_OPEN_NO_MARGIN_TEMPLATE — the built-in defaults put InstantOpenWithCustomVA there instead, which would have silently broken any hedger expecting HyperEVM's layout.
